summary: The session focuses on the concept of agentic workflows and their application in modern data and AI practices. It emphasizes the need for convergence between operational and analytical architectures to leverage quality data effectively. The speaker discusses the importance of data quality and readiness for AI use cases, highlighting the role of agents in enhancing business processes.

key_points: Understanding the AI mandate for data leaders
Defining agentic workflows and their application
The rise of agentic transformation in enterprises
The impact of data sprawl and the need for governance
The need for operational and analytical architecture convergence
How agentic workflows can replace traditional processes
Identifying deterministic processes suitable for automation
The importance of clean and connected data
Stages of data readiness for AI use cases
Strategies for curating metadata for agents
The significance of business context in agentic workflows
Overview of the Boomi platform for agentic workflows
Invitation to learn more at the Boomi booth

key_takeaways: Agentic workflows represent a significant shift in how data and AI can be utilized in business processes.
Convergence of operational and analytical architectures is essential for maximizing the value of data.
Data quality and readiness are critical for successful AI implementations, requiring a focus on clean and connected data.
